summary.text: Lauren Nelson is a Republican state senator from South Dakota Senate District 18 who assumed office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, when she faces Democrat Kay Swihart.
A teacher by profession, she was born in Sinai, South Dakota.

paragraphs.text: Lauren Nelson was born in Sinai, South Dakota.
She earned a bachelor's degree from South Dakota State University, and her career experience includes working as a teacher.
Nelson assumed office in the South Dakota State Senate on January 14, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session she is assigned to the Senate Education Committee and the Senate Local Government Committee.
